principle: Structural debt accumulates through durational asymmetry where extended preparation creates obligation that compressed planning denies, forcing execution to liquidate debt through real-time expenditure rather than montage efficiency.

nodes.label: Tripartite durational asymmetry
nodes.description: The 207-minute runtime divides into three acts with measurable imbalance: roughly 90-minute recruitment, 45-minute preparation, 72-minute combat. Extended recruitment creates structural debt that compressed preparation cannot resolve, forcing combat into durational expenditure rather than montage efficiency.
evidence: Explicit runtime measurements: ~90 minutes recruitment, ~45 minutes preparation, ~72 minutes siege.
Average shot length shifts from ~18 seconds in Act I recruitment to ~3 seconds in Act II montage.
Stage 4 classifies this as central with high confidence: remove it and the work becomes episodic rather than architectonic.

nodes.label: Serial recruitment vignettes
nodes.description: Seven samurai enter through discrete, self-contained sequences with minimal cross-contamination: Kambei via hostage rescue, Gorobei via wood-splitting test, Kyuzo via duel demonstration, Kikuchiyo via persistent rejection, and so on. Each vignette is a closed structural unit establishing individuated character investment.
evidence: Seven discrete sequences with measurable self-containment, each producing complete character establishment.
Remove one samurai and six discrete sequences remain; the recruitment logic persists at pattern level.
Seriality is decorative at unit level but load-bearing at pattern level per the structural inventory.

nodes.label: Real-time combat versus montage preparation
nodes.description: Act III uses 2-8 second real-time sword engagements with zero temporal ellipsis, holding the full arc of each strike, contrasting with Act II montage compression at 3-second average shot length. Combat refuses the efficiency that the preparation phase established as operational grammar.
evidence: Shot length measurements: ~3 second Act II average versus ~18 second recruitment baseline; no combat engagement is compressed by montage.
Kurosawa holds on the full arc of each strike: draw, swing, impact, follow-through.
Stage 4 rates this medium: removal test requires inference about experiential impact.
rules: Combat engagements are shown in real time with zero temporal ellipsis

nodes.label: Three-plane depth staging
nodes.description: Kurosawa populates three distinct depth planes within single shots, foreground at 0-10 feet, middle ground at 10-30 feet, background beyond 30 feet, with independent blocking on each plane. This maintains spatial complexity without cutting and supports geometric composition across scale changes.
evidence: Example staging: Kambei static in foreground, farmers in lateral movement in middle ground, bandits as horizontal line on background ridge.
Stage 4 classifies this as supporting with high confidence: it enables geometric crowd composition and spatial legibility.
rules: Foreground, middle ground, and background are simultaneously populated and legible

nodes.label: Weather as phase-change marker
nodes.description: Rain appears exclusively in Act III, coinciding with the first bandit death and persisting through resolution. Acts I and II have zero precipitation. The dry-to-wet shift provides an absolute boundary between preparation and execution, and transforms ground surface from stable to unstable.
evidence: Rain confined to the final battle; Acts I and II occur under clear or overcast skies.
Rain sound density at roughly 60-70 dB masks dialogue and forces tactical communication through gesture and position.
Stage 4 rates this medium: the tripartite structure would survive without it.

nodes.label: Wipe transitions as structural punctuation
nodes.description: Approximately 42 wipe transitions appear exclusively at structural boundaries: between recruitment vignettes, between preparation montage segments, between discrete combat engagements. Zero wipes occur mid-scene. Presence signals chapter closure; absence signals continuity.
evidence: Approximate count of 42 wipes with systematic positional logic, none mid-scene except the single Heihachi violation.
Stage 4 rates this medium: wipes make chapter structure explicit but do not generate it.
rules: Wipes appear exclusively at structural boundaries, never mid-scene

nodes.label: Telephoto lens compression in battle scenes
nodes.description: Battle scenes use estimated 200-400mm telephoto lenses that compress depth and flatten spatial relationships, making seven samurai and roughly thirty bandits appear as larger forces through spatial flattening.
evidence: Fighters appear closer together than blocking would suggest, creating visual density from limited extras.
Stage 3 identifies its inverse function: it generates spatial illegibility during the final battle when tactical clarity is most critical.

nodes.label: Geometric crowd composition
nodes.description: Human figures arranged in triangular, diagonal, and radial formations legible across depth planes: villagers in tight triangular masses, samurai along diagonal lines during tactical discussions, bandits as horizontal lines on ridges. Schemas operate independently of shot scale.
evidence: Triangle pattern appears in both extreme long shots at village gate assemblies and medium shots in interior council scenes.
Load-bearing for spatial legibility across the film's frequent reframings per the inventory.

nodes.label: Progressive nondiegetic score reduction
nodes.description: Nondiegetic score presence drops from roughly 70 percent in Act I to 40 percent in Act II to 15 percent in Act III, with long stretches of pure diegetic sound in the final battle. The stripping of the interpretive musical layer parallels the stripping of temporal ellipsis.
evidence: Measured ratio shift: 70 to 40 to 15 percent nondiegetic across the three acts.
Stage 5 flags insufficient evidence for full sonic-register integration, so this element is supported but not fully validated.

nodes.label: Circular village geography
nodes.description: The village operates as a bounded circle with two gates and a central plaza. All navigation occurs along radial or circumferential paths with zero diagonal shortcuts, letting viewers track bandit approach vectors and defensive positions through simple geometric relationships.
evidence: Two gates, central plaza, radial and circumferential paths only, per the inventory.
Stage 3: the camera position that would capture Kyuzo's death is structurally unavailable because maintaining the circular geography requires specific sightlines.
rules: Camera positions maintain consistent sightlines preserving circular geometry

nodes.label: Costume as class taxonomy
nodes.description: Four distinct fabric and armor categories with zero cross-contamination: samurai in layered kimono with no armor, farmers in rough-weave hemp earth tones, bandits in stolen mismatched armor over textile. Enables instant class identification across chaotic crowd scenes.
evidence: Four categories with zero cross-contamination documented in the inventory.
Stage 4 classifies it as incidental: functional for crowd legibility but replaceable with other identification systems.

nodes.label: Off-screen space as threat reservoir
nodes.description: Bandits enter from off-screen space in roughly 90 percent of entrances; samurai enter from on-screen space in roughly 90 percent of theirs. Spatial origin alone establishes bandits as external threat and samurai as internal defense, enabling threat prediction.
evidence: 90 percent consistency in both directions per the inventory.
Stage 2: this correspondence enables the circular geography to function as tactical diagram.
rules: Off-screen entrance marks external threat; on-screen entrance marks ally

nodes.label: Kikuchiyo as taxonomy violator
nodes.description: Kikuchiyo wears a hybrid costume of samurai silhouette in farmer-grade fabric and enters from off-screen space using bandit approach vectors before being revealed as ally. His systematic violations create the visual friction his class-mediator function requires.
evidence: Hybrid costume explicitly violates the four-category taxonomy per the inventory.
His off-screen entrance destabilizes the threat-prediction mechanism for 20 minutes; the system recovers but never regains initial reliability.
rule_violations: Off-screen entrance marks external threat; on-screen entrance marks ally

nodes.label: Dust and mud as movement trace
nodes.description: Ground-level dust clouds mark every rapid movement in exterior scenes; in the final battle, mud replaces dust and provides identical kinetic feedback through splash patterns. Particulate matter maintains movement legibility when the movement source is off-frame or obscured.
evidence: Dust marks running feet, falling bodies, horse hooves; mud splash patterns substitute in the rain.
Stage 4 classifies it as incidental: opportunistic enhancement; combat sequences function without it.

edges.rationale: Serial vignette logic resists temporal compression; each character introduction requires discrete durational allocation that montage cannot reduce without losing individuation. This resistance generates the 90-minute extension that creates the structural debt.

Extended recruitment duration requires equivalent combat duration to honor structural debt; compression in one phase demands expansion in another. Without real-time expenditure in Act III, the debt logic has no liquidation mechanism.

Real-time combat treatment requires stable ground surface legibility; weather transformation to rain forces choreography to incorporate slipping and traction loss that montage would obscure, locking resolution into a distinct wet phase.

Telephoto compression creates visual density but degrades spatial legibility; the mechanism that makes limited forces appear larger simultaneously flattens the depth planes the three-plane staging system depends on, undermining the tactical diagram.
Three-plane depth staging enables geometric crowd composition; without simultaneous foreground-middle-background population, geometric patterns collapse into flat arrangements.

Nondiegetic score reduction tracks temporal compression increase; as shot length decreases from 18 to 3 seconds, musical scaffolding drops from 70 to 15 percent presence, signaling the shift from accumulation to liquidation phase.

Wipe transitions mark structural boundaries exclusively; their presence signals chapter closure while absence signals continuity. Wipes make the vignettes' discreteness explicit, but the vignettes would remain discrete without them.

Circular village geography requires consistent sightlines for tactical legibility; maintaining geometric spatial relationships prevents camera positions that would capture certain moments, structurally excluding Kyuzo's death from the real-time observational contract.
Triangular farmer masses versus diagonal samurai distributions remain legible only because costume provides an immediate class-sorting mechanism across chaotic crowd scenes.

The 90 percent spatial-origin consistency supplies the predictive warrant that makes the circular geography function as tactical diagram: viewers track approach vectors because threat always originates externally.
Kikuchiyo's hybrid costume of samurai silhouette in farmer-grade fabric systematically violates the zero cross-contamination rule, producing the visual friction his class-mediator function requires.
Kikuchiyo enters from off-screen space using bandit approach vectors yet is revealed as ally, inverting the spatial-origin taxonomy and destabilizing threat prediction for 20 minutes.
Dust and mud splash patterns provide kinetic feedback that maintains movement legibility in telephoto-compressed crowd shots where spatial relationships between bodies are obscured.

violated: Foreground, middle ground, and background are simultaneously populated and legible

failure_modes.consequence: Telephoto compression in the final battle collapses the depth planes and produces spatial illegibility precisely when tactical clarity is most critical, undermining the geometric diagram system that enabled earlier orientation. The work exploits this failure: spatial confusion mirrors farmer and samurai confusion.

violated: Combat engagements are shown in real time with zero temporal ellipsis
Camera positions maintain consistent sightlines preserving circular geometry

failure_modes.consequence: The real-time observational contract breaks during Kyuzo's off-screen death; maintaining circular geography requires sightlines that structurally exclude the moment of maximum narrative consequence. The work chooses geometric consistency over temporal completeness.

violated: Foreground, middle ground, and background are simultaneously populated and legible

failure_modes.consequence: Rain acoustic degradation at roughly 60-70 dB compounds visual system failures from telephoto flattening and mud obscuration; neither sonic nor visual registers provide stable information during the final 25 minutes, with no compensating mechanism. The work simply operates in degraded mode.

violated: Off-screen entrance marks external threat; on-screen entrance marks ally

failure_modes.consequence: Kikuchiyo's off-screen entrance inverts the bandit-threat taxonomy for 20 minutes, destabilizing the prediction mechanism that enables tactical legibility. The system recovers when his allegiance clarifies but never regains its initial reliability.

violated: Wipes appear exclusively at structural boundaries, never mid-scene

failure_modes.consequence: The single mid-battle wipe during Heihachi's death violates the boundary-only punctuation rule at the work's structural center, transforming a neutral segmentation device into a potential death marker. The wipe system continues afterward but carries new semantic weight, destabilizing the chapter structure system.

Without the tripartite durational asymmetry, the structural debt and resolution logic collapses; the work becomes episodic rather than architectonic, a series of discrete sequences with no accumulated obligation forcing real-time expenditure.

asserted_removal_tests.M1: If removed, the work becomes conventionally paced drama without debt-resolution architecture; the experiential weight of combat collapses into generic action sequences.
asserted_removal_tests.M2: If removed, seven samurai become undifferentiated ensemble; the work loses its identity as character construction through serialized episodes and the debt-tracking mechanism has no granular units to
asserted_removal_tests.M3: If removed and combat uses montage compression, the debt liquidation mechanism vanishes; durational investment from recruitment has no equivalent payment form and structural promise remains
asserted_removal_tests.M4: If removed, geometric crowd compositions collapse into flat arrangements and spatial legibility degrades, though the analysis holds it could be replaced with alternative spatial systems without changing the work's identity.
asserted_removal_tests.M5: If removed, the Act III boundary loses its absolute dry-to-wet marker and combat choreography loses slipping and traction loss, but the tripartite structure survives.
asserted_removal_tests.M6: If removed and replaced with cuts, the chapter structure becomes ambiguous, but the serial vignettes remain discrete; wipes make the structure explicit rather than generating it.
